messages:
mia (Support): incoming high-severity ticket from customer C-9832 — multiple users can't open Billing and Model Deploy pages after last night's RBAC changes. Ticket #23011. Escalating to RBAC/security/SRE.
sofie (Support): I reproduced in a staging org. GET /orgs/C-9832/billing -> 403, no rate-limit headers. Screenshot in ticket.
raj (RBAC): Which rollout id are we talking about? I merged the role-normalization PR last night, pinging the deploy logs.
deploy-bot: Rollout completed: rbac/normalize-roles-2026-03-14 deploy_id=rbac-v2-20260314 actor=raj at=1761972000
audit-bot: AUDIT: policy_change id=rbac/normalize-roles-2026-03-14 actor=raj commit=abc123
adrian (SRE): Can someone paste a failing curl (strip tokens) + the user id so I can trace auth-edge and caches.
mia (Support): sanitized repro:
```
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\" \"https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/C-9832/billing\"\nHTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden\ncontent-type: application/json\n{\"error\":\"insufficient_permissions\",\"missing\":[\"billing.view\"]}\n```
raj (RBAC): Oof. When I normalized product_admin -> org_admin mapping I accidentally removed billing.view from one role mapping. Quick diff:
```
- product_admin: [models.deploy, settings.manage, billing.view]
+ product_admin: [models.deploy, settings.manage]
```
I didn't notice the legacy billing.view alias — my bad.
oliver (Security): @raj please check whether billing.view is tied to any KMS key policies or audit log access. Also we should open an incident record.
raj (RBAC): Starting a rollback to pre-refactor commit def456 now. ETA 3-6m.
deploy-bot: Revert started: rollback rbac/normalize-roles-2026-03-14 -> commit=def456 initiated at=1762100300 by=raj
adrian (SRE): Auth cache still serving new (broken) mapping for a few edges. Flushing auth-perm caches across edge cluster now.
adrian (SRE): flush API call used:
```
curl -X POST https://infra.redwood.internal/cache/flush -d '{\"scope\":\"auth-perm\",\"target\":\"edge-*\"}'
```
adrian (SRE): flush completed at=1762100325
sofie (Support): Quick smoke with 4 users in C-9832 — billing and model pages now return 200 for all of them.
mia (Support): Customer confirms access restored for all affected users. Attaching audit entries and screenshots in the ticket.
oliver (Security): Treating this as sev3. Raj, please write a short postmortem: root cause, missing test coverage, rollout gating, KMS checklist. Include audit-bot timeline and list of impacted orgs.
raj (RBAC): Will do. I pushed a PR that reintroduces billing.view mapping and adds unit + integration tests: https://git.internal/redwood/rbac/pull/482. Also adding a canary gate (1% orgs) for role mapping changes and an automated rollback job in the console CI.
oliver (Security): Add an explicit step in the KMS integration checklist: any role -> permission change must be evaluated against KMS key usage policies and service-account grants.
adrian (SRE): I'll add a runbook entry: cache-flush playbook, and create an alert that fires if >5 403s on /orgs/*/billing in a 10m window.
sofie (Support): Updating support escalation doc: how to collect audit-bot entries, repro curl, and how to request rollback playbook.
mia (Support): Closing ticket after attaching logs and customer confirmation. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :heart:
